_note: shot-recipes 自有的语汇样片：一个故事串起全部镜头语汇，2 个人物 / 3 个空间 / 3 件道具。每一格点名它主要演示的那张卡。check 深度遍历任意 JSON，只认同时带 recipe 与 frame 的对象。
title: 回信
logline: 儿子回到父亲的老房子，桌上摆着一封信。父子为这封信坐了一下午。最后儿子走了，信留在桌上。
logline_en: A son comes back to his father's old flat. A letter sits on the table. They sit with it all afternoon. He leaves; the letter stays.

cast.look: short black hair, dark blue work jacket over a grey-green shirt tucked into his trousers
grey-flecked short hair, dark grey cardigan over a buttoned shirt

props.en: a folded brown paper letter, no readable writing
a red enamel vacuum flask with a brushed metal cap and a side handle
a white enamel mug with a red rim and a lid

cuts.zh: 航拍一片旧居民楼，只有一栋的四层窗口是暖的，那是父亲家。

sections.subject: product
sections._note: 产品那一组不搭影棚白底，就拍桌上这两件器物，背景沉进暗处让轮廓读得干净。90 年代的搪瓷器天然无品牌，正好符合产品卡「不许有 logo」的纪律。

cuts.zh: 搪瓷缸落到桌面正中，停住。
cuts.frame: medium shot of the round tabletop, the white enamel mug with a red rim coming down into the centre of the wood, settles into place with one small rattle of its lid, short travel distance of about a hand's width from just above the table, no hands in frame, the room behind sunk dark so the mug silhouette reads clean, the warm bare bulb from above as the key and one cold blue edge from the window on the left, no filter and no colour cast, shadows keep detail, fine film grain, soft highlights, no logo and no readable text, clean product still, 16:9

sections.subject: vlog
sections._note: 1995 年没有口播，所以这一组理解成「一个人对着镜头讲这件事」，像纪录片的采访镜头——它同时是口播机位，也是故事的一部分。

cuts.zh: 儿子坐在圆桌前正对镜头，讲这封信的来历。
cuts.frame: medium shot of the son seated at the round table, speaker facing the lens straight on, framed centre with his eyes on the upper third line, subtle breathing motion and small natural blinks with nothing else moving, telling where the letter came from, the near edge of the round table crossing the bottom of frame, chest-high pale green wainscot and cracked white plaster behind him, the bare bulb hanging in the upper right as the warm key, the blue glass window in the upper left as cold fill, no filter and no colour cast, shadows keep detail, fine film grain, soft highlights, no logo and no readable text, cinematic film still, 16:9
